options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: goal_location
options.description:
What should the goal stage be? Goals are in their vanilla locations
Utopia Shelter: Defeat the final boss within Utopia Shelter to goal
Freom Mk-0: Defeat the secret Freom boss to goal
Requirements Only: Goal automatically sends upon meeting the progression requirements and going to the World Map

options.name: progression_mode
options.description:
What should be the mode of progression for this player?

Gates: Similar to Sonic Adventure 2 AP, levels are placed in gates with very configurable requirements to move to the next gate
Vanilla Entrance Randomizer: The world map is unlocked like in vanilla Spark 3
Level Items: You must find levels in the stages in order to progress. Levels are in their vanilla locations
Open World: All levels are unlocked from the start, effectively Gates but with only Gate 0
        - The goal level is the only exception. Progression Options denote the requirements
        - Levels are in their vanilla locations

options.name: ability_rando
options.description:
Randomize the abilities Spark normally can use into the item pool
        (Double Jump, Wall Jump/Walk, Dash, Charge Dash, Down Dash, Jester Dash, Combat)

options.name: gimmick_rando
options.description: Puts the stage gimmicks into the item pool

options.name: character_logic
options.description:
Should characters be relevant in logic? Does not affect the unlock requirements for Utopia Shelter
You may still be required to use energy with Fark

options.name: energy_logic
options.description: Should energy-requiring moves be relevant in logic? You may be required to restart the stage multiple times

options.name: difficulty
options.description:
How difficult should the logic be
WARNING: At the moment the difficulty is all over the place.
If you have a suggestion or a question, please ask in the future game design thread

normal: The easiest option, designed for those new to the game
hard: You will need to be observant of the stage layout and know how to best utilize Spark's movement and simple tech
expert: Requires knowledge for hard difficulty as well as less simple speedrun tricks. All tricks are fair game

options.name: spark2_stages
options.description: Adds the 14 Spark 2 stages

options.name: starting_stages
options.description:
Which locations are you guaranteed to start with?
If a goal stage is not in this list and has checks/goal, it will be put into the item pool
If progression is set to Gates, these locations are guaranteed to always be accessible (with exception to the goal)
If the goal is "Requirements Only", you will need the "Requirements Unlocked" item to goal (which this option gives by default)

options.name: sphere_zero_list
options.description: What is the list of stages that may be used for starting level with Level Items or guaranteed gate 0 stages with Gates

options.name: freedom_count
options.description: How many freedom medals to put into the item pool.

options.name: freedom_required
options.description: What's the required percentage of freedom medals to unlock Utopia Shelter

options.name: require_characters
options.description: Should Fark and Sfarx be required to unlock Utopia Shelter?

options.name: required_completion
options.description: What percentage of levels in a gate (rounding up) should be completed before unlocking the next?

options.name: required_speed
options.description: What percentage of speed medals should be required per level gate

options.name: speed_type
options.description: Should the required speed medals be gold, diamond or both

options.name: required_score
options.description: What percentage of score medals should be required per level gate

options.name: score_type
options.description: Should the required score medals be gold, diamond or both

options.name: required_explore
options.description: What percentage of stages should be explored to unlock Utopia Shelter

options.name: gate_zero_completions
options.description: How many stages from the Sphere 0 list should be in the first gate? Increasing this can help with generation errors

options.name: explore_hunt
options.description: Add a location to each stage for collecting all explore medals

options.name: exploresanity
options.description: Adds the 180 exploration medals as checks (300 with Spark 2 stages)

options.name: scoresanity
options.description: Adds the 14 gold and/or 14 diamond score medals to the location pool. (28 each with Spark 2 stages)

options.name: speedsanity
options.description:
Adds the 30 gold and/or 30 diamond speed medals to the location pool. (44 each with Spark 2 stages)
WARNING: Logic Not Implemented

options.name: shopsanity
options.description: Adds the 26 shop checks to the location pool

options.name: coinsanity
options.description: Adds the 72 collectable coins in the collectathon stages as checks and optionally put them in the item pool

options.name: checkpointsanity
options.description: Adds the 237 checkpoints as checks (326 with Spark 2 stages)

options.name: batterysanity
options.description: Adds the 13 batteries in car stages as checks (making the car not useless)

options.name: downdash_buttons
options.description:
By default, Down Dash isn't a very progressive item, only being useful for 1 check
This option adds buttons that you need to logically Down Dash onto as locations
The exact number may change between releases

options.name: goal_checks
options.description:
Which goal locations should have checks inside them? If the current goal location is included, the completion checks will not be randomized
The unlock requirements for each of these is the level item
"Utopia Shelter" contains
        - 29 checkpoints
"Freom Mk-0" contains
        - no extra checks
"Requirements" sends a completion check when the "Requirements Only" goal would otherwise be reached

options.name: endless_dive_checks
options.description: How many checks should be in Endless Dive

options.name: combat_moves
options.description: Should the 8 combat moves be in the item pool?

options.name: combat_option
options.description:
Under the normal gating mode, Combat hard locks anything past the first gate.
This means you are at the whim of the randomizer to progress past Gate 0
These options can help you progress quicker

Normal: Bosses must be defeated, Combat is placed purely at the randomizer's whim
Local Early: Guarantees the required combat item is in this game and early sphere
Optional Bosses: You do not need to defeat bosses in order to unlock the next gate
Start: Start with combat, takes it out of the item pool

options.name: progressive_combo
options.description:
How many combat items should be in the pool?
These items are progressive, first one provides the ability to fight
and subsequent items give you permanent combo (adjustable in client settings)

options.name: progressive_score
options.description:
How many score multiplier options should be in the pool?
These items are progressive and can be adjusted in client settings

options.name: progressive_timestop
options.description:
How many timestop items should be in the pool?
These items slow down the in-game timer, making the speed medals easier to obtain
These items are progressive and can be adjusted in client settings

options.name: progressive_energy
options.description:
How many progressive energy items should be in the pool?
Each item provides a configurable amount of energy per second
while on the ground, configurable in the client

options.name: trap_chance
options.description: Chance to receive traps instead of filler

options.name: labmode
options.description:
Overrides the ability randomizer and automatically opens all stages, for labbing checks.
WARNING: For development purposes only
